---
title: "Welcome to PageSieve"
---

PageSieve is a browser extension for declarative web scraping. It allows you to define field names and CSS or 
XPath selectors to extract structured data from any website you visit.

Get it on the [Mozilla Addon Store](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/pagesieve/)


## Demo

{{< video /assets/pagesieve-demo-2-short.mp4  width="800" height="400" >}}

## Key Features

- **Point-and-click selection**: Easily discover CSS selectors for any element.
- **Minimal Sidebar UI**: No need to leave your current tab.
- **Local-first**: All scraping is performed entirely within your browser.
- **Reusable Recipes**: Save and share your scrape configurations as JSON files.
